posts.title: When Your Teammate Brings an AI Agent to Pair Programming
posts.excerpt: One developer might be using Claude to implement a feature while another asks Codex to write tests. Both agents can produce useful work, but coordinating their changes introduces questions that a shared editor alone cannot answer.
